child_list.content: Make a Snowman
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content: Making a snowman is fun in winter. When it snows, my friends and I like to go outside and make snowmen together. We make a big snowball for his body and a small snowball as his head. We use sticks for his arms, rocks for his eyes and a carrot for his nose. We wrap a scarf around his neck and place a hat on his head. It’s so much fun! We laugh and play in the snow all day.

child_list.content: Hello, hello, hello
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 堆雪人
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 在冬天堆雪人很有趣。 下雪的时候，我和我的朋友们喜欢一起出去堆雪人。我们做了一个大雪球做他的身体，一个小雪球做他的头。我们用木棍做他的胳膊，石头做他的眼睛，胡萝卜做他的鼻子。我们在他的脖子上围了一条围巾，在他头上戴了一顶帽子。 太有趣了！我们一整天在雪地里欢笑、玩耍。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
